source_scope.duplicates: Preserved in source order, no new coordinates. Capped retained witnesses, not full failure set or continuous coverage.
source_scope.native_surface: Literal MANO anatomical skin triangles; not asserted to be an exposed union boundary or a non-self-intersecting solid.

geometry_reference.hand: 45 actual compiled, object-compatible Shadow colliders; per-mesh convex hull plus exact analytic primitives. Includes forearm/wrist carriers in whole union and burial.
geometry_reference.part_subset: Boundary of whole occupied collider union intersect boundary of any collider of requested anatomical part.
geometry_reference.simulator_distinction: Occupied-union accessibility diagnostic is distinct from MuJoCo pairwise contact generation. No physics/contact-success claim.
geometry_reference.object: Frozen prior object poses and colliders. Queries are existing visual-object surface sites. No new object geometry cause audit; prior visual/collision distinction and saved visual-membership diagnostics preserved.

method.occupancy: Any component signed distance < -eps certifies strict component/union interior; all >eps certifies exterior. Otherwise boundary/coincident UNRESOLVED; touching component faces may be inside union.
method.exposure: At only the nearest global and nearest requested-part component points, own signed-distance residual <=eps and all other signed distances >eps provide a strictly separated exposed-point witness. Any other signed distance <-eps is buried. Coincident/near/own-residual cases unresolved.
method.outside_whole_union: Minimum absolute component distance is exact conditional on strict exterior, consistent oracle and no contradictory burial; ties do not imply unique normal.
method.inside_whole_union: Maximum component penetration depth is conditional lower bound. An available strictly separated candidate gives an upper bound. Otherwise upper=null.
method.part_subset: Minimum individual-component surface distance is lower bound. A strictly separated same-part candidate is upper; if the minimum part candidate is exposed, distance is exact conditional. No exposed point found does not prove subset empty.
method.oracle_validation: All SDF versus query-to-closest distance residuals and both candidates own-surface residuals <=eps; nonfinite/malformed oracle aborts; inconsistency refuses bounds and exact claims.
method.numeric_claim: Floating reconstructed-geometry diagnostics, not interval-certified machine proofs. No normal uniqueness or new orientation sign claims.

proximity_diagnostic: A bound-based persistence check is separately labelled conditional: enlarge source cell error by additional eps, apply original strict far / inclusive near mask, preserve historical pass/fail. Failure to prove persistence is NOT evidence of repair.
pose_gates: Exact original native-world tip caps, mean <=10mm, original fixed quaternion/physical and q0±.35/translation AABB; fresh source reconstruction and 1e-12 replay agreement. Pose gates are unchanged historical project rules, not claimed HUG published thresholds.
limitations: No CSG reconstruction or global inside nearest-boundary solution.
No exposure proof from finite probes, nonnegative SDF alone, or removing buried candidates.
Neither zero measured discrepancies nor numerical exact claims establish whole-surface mapping validation.
